subject: general
question:
Out of the four letter-clusters listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

CF, OR, VX, AD
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130e026a7c3720f6f9db70163ea219cbcf01f13f419b49f6b5b6c1ad7f909510.png] 

First we will check all the options as:

1) CF:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df3ec8fae645ac7963b9b6525aa187dbdf3ceb6b10e75877c25cf574982d9ef1.png] 

2) AD:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83868656a22df2bf98f78ee046ac9616affc443a005ffe2969eede3a9ac7f802.png] 

3) OR:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44022ae71b9a3fe3b1189b8aacc34cc19677e9714c7000b5c7186819817f47e7.png] 

4) VX:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c60181f8a6681507fe6e3720f6f4166f92fa2c0d902c5da86e8f030abd92c2.png]
